mapper.select: SELECT dv_id, dv_name, dv_addr, dv_addr_detail, dv_lat, dv_lng, dv_status_pc, dv_status_cctv, dv_lens, dv_status_speaker, dv_status_sip, dv_status_updated FROM tbl_device WHERE dv_lat IS NOT NULL AND dv_lat != 0 AND dv_lng IS NOT NULL AND dv_lng != 0 ORDER BY dv_id
SELECT dv_id, dv_name, dv_addr, dv_addr_detail, dv_status_pc, dv_status_cctv, dv_lens, dv_status_speaker, dv_status_sip, dv_status_updated FROM tbl_device WHERE dv_id = #{dvId}

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN ev_action = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS guide_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN ev_action = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS enforce_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN ev_action = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fine_cnt FROM tbl_event_data WHERE ev_dv_id = #{dvId} AND LEFT(ev_date, 8) = DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y%m%d')

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN ev_action = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS guide_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN ev_action = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS enforce_cnt FROM tbl_event_data WHERE LEFT(ev_date, 8) = DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y%m%d')
SELECT ev_id, ev_dv_id, ev_dv_name, ev_car_num, ev_cd, ev_action, ev_date, ev_reg_date, ev_img_path FROM tbl_event_data ORDER BY ev_reg_date DESC, ev_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
